external_ref.description: Stable id of the Second Brain project

confirm.description: Must be exactly "DELETE ALL MY THOUGHTS"

suggest_relations.title: Suggest Relations
suggest_relations.description: Ask the LLM to label relations; stored as suggestions only

source.title: Source
source.description: Client kind. Ignored for service tokens (fixed per client).

ReplyCreate.description: A continuation of an existing thought; joins (or starts) its thread.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: When given, the restore fails on a concurrent edit.

semantic.title: Semantic
semantic.description: ok | disabled | unavailable | not_permitted | not_requested | no_embedding

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Only returned at login. Also set as the readable CSRF cookie; send it back in the X-CSRF-Token header on every unsafe request.

ai_external_enabled.title: Ai External Enabled
ai_external_enabled.description: Explicit consent to send selected thoughts to external AI providers (embeddings, LLM, ASR). Off by default.

source.title: Source
source.description: Client kind. Ignored for service tokens (fixed per client).

ThoughtUpdate.title: ThoughtUpdate
ThoughtUpdate.description: Partial update. ``expected_version`` is required: optimistic locking.

items.title: Items
items.description: Depth-first order: each reply under its parent

language.title: Language
language.description: Omit for mixed-language speech: the model detects it.

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: Exactly what the ASR model produced

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: PUT the raw bytes here (owner session + CSRF).

direct_upload_url.title: Direct Upload Url
direct_upload_url.description: Optional short-lived presigned S3 PUT URL
